name: Matsuyama (Yamagata, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Matsuyama town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised arrowhead pointing upwards.
history: Flag of the former town of Matsuyama in Yamagata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-11-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1962.

features.role: Matsuyama town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised arrowhead pointing upwards
